query:
SELECT
                 COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE state = 'confirmed'), 0)::text AS "settled!",
                 COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE state = ANY($4)), 0)::text AS "reserved!"
               FROM intents_view
               WHERE agent_id = $1 AND asset = $2 AND created_at >= $3
